en.stem: Time constant of an inductive circuit
options: increases with the increase of inductance and the decrease of resistance
increases with the increase of inductance and the increase of resistance
increases with the decrease of inductance and the decrease of resistance
increases with the decrease of inductance and the increase of resistance
en.quick: For an RL circuit the time constant is τ=L/R. It increases when inductance increases and when resistance decreases, because larger L resists current change while larger R dissipates energy faster.

प्रेरकत्व घटने और प्रतिरोध घटने पर बढ़ता है
प्रेरकत्व घटने और प्रतिरोध बढ़ने पर बढ़ता है
hi.quick: A — RL परिपथ में τ = L/R। यह L बढ़ने और R घटने पर बढ़ता है, क्योंकि बड़ा L धारा परिवर्तन का विरोध करता है जबकि बड़ा R ऊर्जा तेज़ी से व्यय करता है।

gu.quick: A — RL પરિપથમાં τ = L/R. તે L વધવા અને R ઘટવાથી વધે છે, કારણ કે મોટો L પ્રવાહ ફેરફારનો વિરોધ કરે છે જ્યારે મોટો R ઊર્જા ઝડપથી વ્યય કરે છે.
